scope_note: TF (toroidal-field) ripple diagnostic only. Does NOT constitute a free-boundary POLOIDAL equilibrium solve; no PF/shaping coil data was supplied. PF/free-boundary closure remains a separate blocked gate.
provenance_warning: CAD-A2 uses the exact CAD-A2 centerline generated from the Rev1.7 winding envelope and a separate model-derived current rerun using the 100-turn reference count recovered from the Kaggle output. It is not an as-built electrical schedule.
method: Exact closed-form Biot-Savart (Hanson & Hirshman 2002) summed over all real coil filament segments; validated against the analytic on-axis field of a circular loop to 7 significant figures (see accompanying test).
ripple_screening_threshold_provenance: Literature range ~0.3-0.5% (ITER; de Vries et al., Nucl. Fusion 48, 035007, 2008) up to ~2% tolerated in tight-aspect-ratio compact devices before mitigation (FAST, ORNL-EPR). This is a provisional screening threshold, not a certified design limit.
